upnp_network_scan.label: Allow network scan for UPnP discovery
upnp_network_scan.description: Enable additional broadcast-based SSDP discovery. Use this if some UPnP/DLNA devices do not answer regular discovery.

private_trial_target.label: Private trial target device
private_trial_target.description: Private trial only. The single device this profile may resolve, probe and register, as <12 hex MAC>@<advertised name>. While unset, no directed mDNS query, device probe or player registration happens at all. Reload the AirPlay provider after setting it; never use it in production.

manifest.name: Discovery
manifest.description: Handles mDNS/Zeroconf, SSDP/UPnP discovery and Music Assistant network broadcast.
